name: Happiest Minds Technologies Limited
summary: Happiest Minds Technologies Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides information technology (IT) solutions and services in India, the Americas, Australia, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates in three segments: Infrastructure Management and Security Services (IMSS); Product and Digital Engineering Services (PDES); and Generative AI Business Services (GBS). The IMSS segment provides end-to-end infrastructure and security solutions comprising advisory, transformation, managed and hosted services, and secure intelligence solutions with specialization in cloud, virtualization and mobility across a multitude of industry verticals and geographies.
